h1: The 6 Best Office Supply Carts Under $100 of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Supply Carts Under $100: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: six rolling office supply carts under $100, compared on tiers, drawers, wheels and listed weight capacity.
summary: The Goovilla 3 Tier cart is our top pick for a removable top drawer and a stated 124 lb capacity. The SUNALLY 8-drawer cart is the choice for sorting small supplies, and the YASONIC metal carts offer heavy-duty 2 inch wheels. All six cost under $100.
intro: Cheap rolling carts all look alike in photos, and the mistake is buying on tier count. What separates a cart you like from one that wobbles is the frame material, the wheels and whether the listing states a weight rating.

We reviewed rolling carts under $100 and ranked them on listed capacity, drawers, wheels and frame details. Four are three-tier utility carts and one is a drawer unit. All of them fall under the $100 mark.

products.name: Goovilla 3 Tier Rolling Utility Cart Organizer with Removable Drawer
products.verdict: A stated 124 lb capacity and a removable top drawer.
products.description:
The Goovilla is a 3-tier rolling cart with a removable drawer on top and safety protection on the wheels. The listing says it holds up to 124 lbs for daily use, and it costs under $25.

The stated weight rating is what puts it first. Most carts here do not give one, and the removable drawer lets you carry small supplies to your desk.

It suits everyday desk-side storage. The caveat is that it is a three-tier design, not a drawer unit.

products.name: SUNALLY Rolling Cart With 8 Drawers,Storage Drawer Cart for Craft Art,Green
products.verdict: Eight drawers on a powder-coated steel frame.
products.description:
The SUNALLY is a rolling cart with 8 drawers on a powder-coated steel frame, in the $25 to $50 range.

Eight drawers sort small supplies far better than open tiers, which is why it sits high. It does not state a weight rating the way the Goovilla does.

It suits crafts and sorted supplies. The caveat is the lack of a listed capacity.

products.name: YASONIC 3 Tier Metal Rolling Cart
products.verdict: A metal 3-tier cart with 2 inch heavy-duty wheels.
products.description:
The YASONIC is a 3-tier metal rolling cart with a high-quality coating and 2 inch heavy-duty wheels, in the $25 to $50 range.

The wheels are what the listing stresses, saying it moves easily under heavy loads. Against the Goovilla it costs a little more and states no weight rating.

It suits heavier loads in a home office. The caveat is that no capacity number is given.
products.idealFor: Heavier loads on a rolling cart.
products.skipIf: You want a stated weight rating.

products.name: ZOES HOMEWARE 3 Tier Metal Rolling Cart on Wheels,Heavy Duty Utility Cart
products.verdict: A 16 by 12 inch footprint with a durable frame and strong wheels.
products.description:
The ZOES HOMEWARE is a 3-tier metal cart that occupies only 16 inches by 12 inches of floor space, with a durable frame and strong wheels. It costs under $25.

The small footprint is its selling point, letting it tuck beside a desk. Against the YASONIC it is cheaper and smaller, with less emphasis on wheel size.

It suits tight spaces. The caveat is the modest size.

products.name: 3 Tier Rolling Utility Cart with Drawer,REBECAT Utility Cart Made of
products.verdict: A 3-tier cart with a drawer and shelves that save space.
products.description:
The REBECAT is a 3-tier rolling utility cart with a drawer, built to save space with storage shelves, in the under $25 bucket.

It matches the Goovilla's drawer idea at the same price, but the listing gives no weight rating and the product title is cut off. That limits how much we can say.

It suits small storage jobs. The caveat is limited detail.
products.idealFor: Small storage jobs on a budget.

products.name: Sywhitta 3-Tier Plastic Rolling Utility Cart with Wheels for Storage,Black
products.verdict: A plastic and iron-pipe cart with 360 degree wheels.
products.description:
The Sywhitta is a 3-tier cart made of plastic and iron pipe, with four wheels that rotate 360 degrees and a handle, in the under $25 bucket.

The swivel wheels make it easy to steer in a tight office. The plastic shelves are the tradeoff next to the metal carts above.

It suits light storage. The caveat is the plastic construction.

whatMatters.detail: This is the load the cart can carry. It matters for books and equipment. Look for a number in pounds in the title or bullets; only the Goovilla lists one.
Metal frames resist flexing while plastic can sag. Check the listing for steel or metal wording.
Wheels decide how easily it rolls under load. The YASONIC lists 2 inch heavy-duty wheels. Check the wheel size.
Drawers sort small supplies and hide clutter. The SUNALLY lists eight. Choose by how much small stuff you own.
A smaller base fits beside a desk. The ZOES lists 16 by 12 inches. Measure your gap first.

faq.q: How much weight can these carry?
faq.a: Only the Goovilla lists a figure, up to 124 lbs. For the others, check the product page.
Buying by tier count. Frame and wheels matter more.

faq.q: Is the SUNALLY worth it over a 3-tier cart?
faq.a: If you store many small items, yes. Eight drawers sort better than open shelves.
The listings we reviewed do not say. Check the product page for assembly details.
The YASONIC lists 2 inch wheels and the Sywhitta lists 360 degree wheels. The listings do not discuss carpet.
The listings do not address outdoor use. Check the manufacturer's guidance.

finalTake: The Goovilla 3 Tier cart is the best under-$100 office cart for most people. The SUNALLY is the pick for small supplies, and the YASONIC suits heavier loads. Look for a stated capacity before you buy.
